description: Generate a ready-to-extend FlowZap Code skeleton for a Mind Map. Returns a tree structure with a central circle root, rectangle branches and sub-branches, and optional cross-links between branches. Use this to bootstrap a new mind map.

branches.description: Number of main branches from the root (default: 3, max: 8)

depth.description: Depth of sub-branches per main branch (default: 2, max: 4)

topic.description: Central topic label for the mind map root (default: 'Central Topic')

name: flowzap_mindmap_template
